units.source_text: 这样不相吻合的谈话，对方也没有一点心情烦躁的样子，露出洁白的牙齿，爽朗地笑了。

en.t: Even though the conversation failed to match up like this, the other person showed no sign of irritation at all, but bared white teeth and laughed cheerfully.

units.source_text: 肿肿的眼睛，藏在肉褶皱之间。

en.t: The swollen eyes were hidden among folds of flesh.

units.source_text: 男人也无奈地报以含含糊糊的微笑。

en.t: The man, helpless to do otherwise, answered with a vague smile.

units.source_text: 这可真是麦比乌斯圈呐。

en.t: This really was a Mobius strip.

units.source_text: 不管是好意，还是恶意，都是麦比乌斯圈。

en.t: Whether it was goodwill or malice, it was all a Mobius strip.

units.source_text: 仅就好的一面来说，还是值得对麦比乌斯圈表示充分敬意的。

en.t: Looking only at its good side, the Mobius strip was still worthy of full respect.
